# LightConeAngles

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Lights](Blitz3D-Lights)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LightConeAngles:Void light:Int32, inner_angle:Float32, outer_angle:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `light` | In | Int32 | required | Light handle. |
| `inner_angle` | In | Float32 | required | Angle of the fully lit center of the cone. |
| `outer_angle` | In | Float32 | required | Angle where the light has faded out. |

## Description

Sets the inner and outer angle of a spot light in degrees. Inside the inner angle the light is at full strength and it fades out up to the outer angle. The defaults are 0 and 90.
